ngaap.guidance: 2026 guidance initiated 29-Jan-2026 on the new three-segment structure (effective Q1-26) and with diluted EPS presented on a GAAP basis (transition from non-GAAP diluted EPS): Revenue - Space & Mission Systems ~$11.5B; Communication & Spectrum Dominance ~$8.0B; Missiles Solutions ~$4.4B; Total (net of intersegment eliminations) $23B - $23.5B. Segment operating margin - Space & Mission Systems mid 10%; Communication & Spectrum Dominance ~25%; Missiles Solutions mid 12%; Total low 16%. Diluted EPS (GAAP) $11.30 - $11.50. Free cash flow $3.0B (net cash provided by operating activities ~$3.6B less capital expenditures ~$600M). The Space Technology disposal group (majority-stake sale announced 5-Jan-2026, expected to close in the second half of 2026) is included in the guidance, which will be updated at closing. The release gives no 2026 assumptions for tax rate, interest expense, pension (FAS/CAS, non-service FAS pension income) or share count: "Supplemental information is provided in accompanying Earnings Presentation" (not an SEC exhibit in the source set).
ngaap.notes: From Q1-25 Non-GAAP diluted EPS no longer adds back amortization of acquisition-related intangibles (2024 comparatives recast: the amortization add-back and its tax effect removed); it = diluted EPS + merger, acquisition and divestiture-related expenses + business divestiture-related losses (gains) / impairment of goodwill and other assets + LHX NeXt implementation costs (+ accrued corporate charge in Q4-25) + "income taxes on above adjustments and other, net". Pension adjusted non-GAAP diluted EPS = non-GAAP diluted EPS less the after-tax per-share FAS/CAS operating adjustment and non-service FAS pension income. Adjusted segment operating income = operating income excluding all unallocated corporate items (incl. amortization of acquisition-related intangibles, corporate department expense, FAS/CAS operating adjustment and the significant items) and, from Q4-25, segment impairment of goodwill and other assets; i.e. the sum of segment operating income (+ segment impairments). Effective tax rate on non-GAAP income excludes the amortization add-back from 2025 (2024 comparatives recast: e.g. Q1-24 5.5% vs 13.1% originally). Free cash flow = operating cash flow - capital expenditures + proceeds from disposal of PP&E; adjusted free cash flow adds cash used for merger, acquisition and severance. Organic revenue excludes completed divestitures (antenna May-2024, AOT Jan-2025, CAS Mar-2025). Q4-25 adds "Accrued corporate charge" ($30M, a non-recurring matter unrelated to segment activities) and "Segment impairment of goodwill and other assets" ($85M at AR, Space Technology disposal group) to the adjustments; the divestiture / impairment item of $150M = 65 at corporate + 85 at the segment. The fourth-quarter free cash flow bridge is recorded (release Table 8 quarter column). From 2026 the company guides GAAP diluted EPS and free cash flow (not adjusted) only.
